test.result: 37 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Immutable threshold, period ordering, validation start and changed-policy hash mismatch are tested.

implemented: A frozen hurdle binds its threshold to a development date range, a strictly later validation start, a named selection method and a SHA-256 training-data identity.
Forward allocation with a frozen policy requires the externally pinned policy digest and rejects policy edits, pre-validation use and a simultaneous mutable threshold argument.
The hurdle value is applied as a net-alpha floor; risk adjustment remains separate.
blockers: The threshold selection itself is caller-supplied; this code does not calculate or verify a training-only calibration report.
The expected policy SHA must be pinned by the strategy/charter registry; no universal runner enforcement is wired yet.
No actual strategy forecast calibration quality or positive paper result is claimed.
scope_note: The immutability and provenance interface is implemented. Training-only selection evidence and universal freeze enforcement are still required.
